name: Sinoptik.ua Weather Informer
description: Provides a block showing a sinoptik.ua weather informer for selected cities.
project_description:
Sinoptik.ua Weather informer for Drupal 8.

 Using this module you are agree with Sinoptik.ua terms & conditions and user agreement .

 Fully supported languages: UA, RU.

Limited support for languages: EN, PL.

 This module adds a block plugin with ability to configure city, language and Sinoptik informer color from administrative UI.

 Sinoptik.ua is a site with weather information mostly for Ukraine.
